composition_note: A new descriptive composition for PORT-001, PORT-002 and PORT-004. Historical cross_case_summary.v0.1 remains unchanged as the record of its original PORT-001/PORT-002/PORT-003 composition.

historically_retained_but_excluded.exclusion_reason: No independent pre-implementation source describes the BEFORE workflow; the prior process is knowable only from AFTER-dated material framed as what the AI replaced.
historically_retained_but_excluded.effect: Retained unchanged as historical metadata. Excluded from every v0.2 forward count, aggregate and conclusion.

production_fingerprint_cohort_limitation: PORT-001 and PORT-002 share the historical Phase 8 production-fingerprint cohort. PORT-004 used a later production fingerprint. The three cases are described together, but this is not one identical frozen-production-baseline cohort and must not be represented as such.

review_profile.detail: Review rejected four unsupported positive capability assertions, corrected one input from document evidence, and retained 117 assertions as unknown.
Review corrected three explicit capability signals the extraction had left unknown, rejected an incorrect forward dependency, resolved the blocking conflict, and retained 123 assertions as unknown.
Review resolved two planning dependencies, made no capability-signal edit, and retained 80 material criteria plus 8 accountability fields as unknown.

deterministic_policy_observation.observed_real_case_gate_behaviour: All 20 source-backed activities passed evidence sufficiency and stopped at technical fit because ai_capability_fit was unknown. No business-value or risk-and-autonomy gate was evaluated, and no priority score was produced.
deterministic_policy_observation.what_this_descriptively_supports: The portfolio demonstrates cautious stopping behaviour and preservation of an evidence gap on these inputs.
deterministic_policy_observation.what_this_does_not_validate: It does not validate threshold choices, weights, later scoring bands, recommendation accuracy, predictive performance, or real-world adoption outcomes. Unit tests may exercise policy branches synthetically, but no included portfolio case reached later gates or scoring bands.

findings.title: Source-bounded process reconstruction held across the three included cases
findings.detail: The 20 retained activities were all source-backed within their frozen inputs, and no unsupported activity was added. This supports evidence-bounded reconstruction of the submitted documents, not independent proof that every activity is a complete operational workflow description.

findings.title: Human review contributed different non-ceremonial controls in every included case
findings.detail: PORT-001 suppressed unsupported capability claims; PORT-002 recovered source-supported signals and corrected structure; PORT-004 resolved dependencies and preserved unknowns without adding a capability. Across the cases, review was neither a rubber stamp nor a uniform rewrite.

findings.title: Capability recognition was relevant but incomplete and generally broad
findings.detail: The product exercised five capabilities across seven activities and achieved seven partial alignments. It recognised document extraction, vision, classification, workflow automation and broad knowledge retrieval, but did not identify later-specific mechanisms such as system transfer, speech and natural-language handling, self-service answering, similarity search, AI-use recordation or explicit control design.

findings.title: Human-control and governance design remained absent from the frozen product findings
findings.detail: Each included AFTER packet documented a human or organisational control boundary. The corresponding themes were all classified NO_DOCUMENTED_ALIGNMENT. Cautious non-deployment is not credited as identifying a control design.

findings.title: The deterministic policy showed cautious gate behaviour but was not validated on later decision bands
findings.detail: All 20 recommendations were INVESTIGATE_FURTHER because ai_capability_fit was unknown at technical fit. The portfolio observes the same conservative gate behaviour in real case inputs, but zero included activities reached business value, risk/autonomy or priority scoring, and no activity received AUTOMATE, AUGMENT or DO_NOT_RECOMMEND. This is not real-world validation of policy judgement or scoring.

findings.title: Zero contradictions does not establish decision accuracy
findings.detail: No theme was classified CONTRADICTION, but the product made no deployment or rejection recommendation in any included case. A consistent INVESTIGATE_FURTHER result avoids conflict with a later intervention without demonstrating predictive or recommendation accuracy.

findings.title: Portfolio evidence is descriptive and has substantial documentation limits
findings.detail: The cases are selected public adoption stories, the AFTER sources are mainly organisation or implementation-partner accounts, outcomes are incomplete or non-comparable, and PORT-004 has no measured outcome in its sealed packet. There is no negative case, true-negative evidence, or basis for statistical, causal, precision/recall, predictive or cross-industry claims.

findings.title: Two production-fingerprint cohorts limit direct comparability
findings.detail: PORT-001 and PORT-002 share fingerprint 4deca425…, while PORT-004 used 3c5c86bd…. The cases can be described in one portfolio but not represented as an identical frozen-baseline cohort.

original_phase1_to_phase7_product: Decision intake, document ingestion, evidence-bounded extraction, human review and approval, deterministic assessment, decision-package generation, and presentation/output were the product under evaluation.
The evaluated product preserved UNKNOWN values, kept AFTER material out of the frozen production inputs, and returned a decision package even when evidence was insufficient.
limitations_revealed_by_validation: Thin process documents often support process reconstruction and broad capability signals but not fit, controls, operational metrics, risk or quantified value needed for a stronger adoption decision.
The product can identify missing information but the historical evaluated workflow had no controlled, customer-friendly mechanism for strengthening selected gaps and requesting reassessment.
Specific intervention mechanisms and governance/control designs were not established from the frozen BEFORE evidence.
post_validation_proposed_extensions: Gap Resolution Workspace (GRW) is a discovered, post-validation extension. It responds to the identified need for optional, prioritised evidence strengthening and reassessment after an initial useful Decision Package. GRW was not part of the original Phase 1-7 architecture and was not implemented or tested in PORT-001, PORT-002 or PORT-004.

The Adoption Execution Layer (AEL) remains future and out of scope. It would govern pilot, implementation, deployment and measured outcomes after an organisation chooses to proceed; it was not part of this evaluation.

honest_headline: Across three valid but two-cohort retrospective cases, the engine reconstructed source-backed process activities, found some broad opportunity overlap, and consistently preserved uncertainty. The portfolio does not validate real-world recommendation accuracy, scoring performance or generalisation.
